metadata.description: Complete Nethermind JSON-RPC API fields and modules for Ethereum node operations
metadata.purpose: Comprehensive reference for all RPC methods, modules, and fields available in Nethermind for use by Ethereum clients like Nimbus

eth_getBlockReceipts.description: Returns receipts for all transactions in a block (Nethermind extension)

eth_accounts.description: Returns list of addresses owned by client

eth_call.description: Executes a new message call without creating a transaction

eth_estimateGas.description: Estimates gas needed for transaction execution

eth_gasPrice.returns: Gas price in wei as hex

eth_getBlockByNumber.usage: Block data retrieval, consensus layer sync

eth_getBlockTransactionCountByHash.description: Returns number of transactions in block by hash

eth_getBlockTransactionCountByNumber.description: Returns number of transactions in block by number

eth_getStorageAt.description: Returns storage value at address position

eth_getTransactionByBlockHashAndIndex.description: Returns transaction by block hash and index

eth_getTransactionByBlockNumberAndIndex.description: Returns transaction by block number and index

eth_getTransactionCount.description: Returns number of transactions sent from address

eth_getUncleByBlockHashAndIndex.description: Returns uncle block by hash and index

eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex.description: Returns uncle block by number and index

eth_getUncleCountByBlockHash.description: Returns number of uncles in block by hash

eth_getUncleCountByBlockNumber.description: Returns number of uncles in block by number

eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: Returns suggested max priority fee per gas

eth_mining.description: Returns true if client is mining

eth_newBlockFilter.description: Creates a filter for new blocks

eth_newPendingTransactionFilter.description: Creates a filter for pending transactions

eth_feeHistory.description: Returns fee history data for recent blocks (EIP-1559)

eth_getFilterChanges.returns: Array of log entries or hashes

eth_getFilterLogs.description: Returns all logs for a filter

eth_getProof.description: Returns Merkle proofs for account and storage slots (EIP-1186)

trace_block.description: Traces all transactions in a block
